description: L4=1.000 across all primary arms for all 5 tasks. The model systematically selects RESOLVE_DECISION/RESOLVE_QUESTION/NOTIFY_REVIEWERS — actions that are lawful in most states. It never selects DEPLOY or OPEN_PR. L4 cannot distinguish between representations.
root_cause: Two compounding factors: (1) the model has a systematic bias toward 'safe' resolution-oriented actions, and (2) the lawful set at the boundary always includes RESOLVE_DECISION, RESOLVE_QUESTION, and NOTIFY_REVIEWERS. The model's bias aligns with the lawful set, making L4 trivially easy.
what_i_did_wrong: Did not test the instrument with states where only DEPLOY or RUN_TESTS is lawful. The pilot only tested boundary positions where the lawful set overlaps with the model's bias.
what_i_should_do_instead: Add test states where the only lawful action is DEPLOY or RUN_TESTS. This would force the model to select actions outside its comfort zone and reveal whether it can actually use the representation to determine lawfulness.
impact: L4 is uninformative as a measurement — it cannot detect differences between representations because all arms achieve 1.000.
